description: This file defines the InstallationDatabaseUserAPI class, which is a REST API controller responsible for handling the creation of a database user during the installation process of OrangeHRM. It extends an abstract controller and utilizes utility functions to perform its task.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class responsible for creating a database user during installation.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a database user using the AppSetupUtility.
